headword: {温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}

definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese inn that features natural hot spring baths, typically offering Japanese-style rooms, meals, and hospitality.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}に{泊|と}まった。
examples.english: I stayed at a hot spring inn on the weekend.

examples.japanese: この{温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}は{露天風呂|ろてんぶろ}が{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: This hot spring inn is famous for its open-air bath.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}で{温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}に{行|い}って、{美味|おい}しい{料理|りょうり}と{温泉|おんせん}を{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: We went to a hot spring inn as a family and enjoyed delicious food and hot springs.

notes:
Composed of {温泉|おんせん} (hot spring) + {旅館|りょかん} (traditional Japanese inn). One of the most iconic types of Japanese accommodation, combining the relaxation of natural hot spring bathing with traditional hospitality.

TYPICAL FEATURES:
- {和室|わしつ}: Japanese-style tatami rooms
- {露天風呂|ろてんぶろ}: open-air baths
- {内湯|うちゆ}: indoor baths
- {懐石料理|かいせきりょうり} or {会席料理|かいせきりょうり}: multi-course Japanese meals
- {浴衣|ゆかた}: yukata provided for guests
- {仲居|なかい}: room attendants

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}に{泊|と}まる: to stay at a hot spring inn
- {温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}を{予約|よやく}する: to book a hot spring inn
- {老舗|しにせ}の{温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}: a long-established hot spring inn

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {旅館|りょかん}: traditional Japanese inn — not necessarily with hot springs
- {民宿|みんしゅく}: family-run guesthouse — simpler, more affordable
- {湯治場|とうじば}: hot spring cure resort — focused on therapeutic bathing
